Rings as the 88two stacked rings make an 8 · try them in the menu bar with the Logo switch

Stacked

Each 8 is a small ring on a bigger one, like a typeset 8. Reads as SD88ME at every size. My pick.

Overlapping

The four-ring mark itself sits in the middle of the name. More symbol than numbers; reads as ∞∞ at a glance.

Sand, dense core

A solid, rough core with grains scattering off it, thinning and shrinking as they go. Holds up at menu-bar size and gets more textured the bigger it is.
